analysis.title: Klaviyo (KVYO) 3Q26: Look for Product Innovation to Stabilize Growth
key_insights: GS keeps KVYO at Neutral (since Oct 16, 2026) and raises the 12-month price target to $22.50 from $20.00 on 18x Q5-Q8 EV/EBIT. Price is $21.36, so upside is 5.3%.
3Q26 revenue was $387mn, 2% above both GSe ($379mn) and Street ($380mn), up 25% y/y. Management raised 2026 revenue guidance by $9mn and implied 2026 EBIT margin guidance by about 120bps.
GS says investors are focused on when revenue growth stabilizes. Growth slowed about 180bps in the quarter, which is more than in the prior two quarters. 4Q guidance implies further deceleration.

NRR fell 100bps q/q to 107% in the recap (the thesis section says 108%) as Klaviyo laps last year's profile enforcement pricing change. Management expects the headwind to stay in the trailing 12-month calculation through 1Q27 and does not expect NRR to rise as it rolls off, because customers increasingly land with several products instead of expanding into them later.
Consumption-based agent revenue could make NRR less representative of customer expansion over time.

Agentic adoption accelerated after the latest Composer release. Daily active accounts more than doubled to over 10,000, weekly credit consumption more than tripled to 18mn, and credits per active account rose 60%.
Scheduled tasks tripled and custom skills doubled. GS reads this as early movement from one-off prompting toward recurring, more autonomous workflows.
Composer users convert from free to paid plans at about 1.5x the rate of non-users. Customer Agent adoption among customers with more than $50k in ARR rose nearly 60% q/q.
Agentic adoption is still early: daily active Composer accounts are only about 5% of Klaviyo's AI daily active accounts. Management stresses adoption before monetization.

Enterprise momentum stayed strong. Customers above $500k in ARR rose 57% y/y to 105, and customers above $250k rose 49% to 390. Customers above $50k in ARR rose 33% y/y. Total customer adds were 6k, down q/q after a very strong 2Q.

Management plans to invest more aggressively in enterprise new-logo acquisition as references, product readiness and external validation improve. The mix still leans toward expansion within the existing base.
The Neutral rating reflects limited visibility into Klaviyo's ability to monetize agents, which GS says creates risk to 2027 estimates. 78% of ARR comes from Shopify merchants.
3Q26 free cash flow was $40mn, 23% below GSe and Street ($52mn), a 10% margin and down 15% y/y.
3Q26 adjusted operating income was $57mn vs $42mn for both GSe and Street, a 15% margin vs 11% expected. Gross margin was 75%, 160bps above GSe and 200bps above Street.

sector_views.rationale: GS is cautious on near-term upside from Klaviyo's agentic products and sees limited visibility on agent monetization.

risk_factors: Positive risks: stronger macro activity, faster monetization of newer products, stronger enterprise momentum, faster international expansion, diversification outside eCommerce, competition, and better profitability.
Negative risks: weaker macro activity, price competition, changes in the Shopify relationship, and inability to diversify outside retail/eCommerce.
Continued NRR declines, with management not expecting a rebound after the profile enforcement impact is lapped in 1Q27.
Agent monetization is unproven and management is prioritizing adoption over monetization.

tension_points.bull_case: Agentic usage is accelerating (daily active accounts over 10,000, weekly credits 18mn) and Composer users convert to paid plans at about 1.5x the rate of non-users. Enterprise customers above $500k ARR rose 57% y/y.
tension_points.bear_case: Adoption is early (Composer is about 5% of AI daily active accounts) and management prioritizes adoption over monetization. NRR keeps falling and is not expected to rebound, and 4Q guidance implies further deceleration.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A rebound in revenue growth as profile enforcement is lapped in 1Q27, or visible agent monetization, would challenge the cautious view. The report does not give a specific level.

theme_stances.key_argument: Investors focus on the path to revenue growth stabilization given deceleration, softer 4Q guidance and falling NRR.
